title: admin-shell workspaces collect navs; includeDocumentDesigner removed
detail: The tenant and platform workspaces of admin-shell now use `collectAdminArea`, so they also list event consumers, export jobs, feature toggles, the cap list and the document templates of mounted features. A new platform nav `admin-shell:nav:users` opens `user:screen:user-list` for SystemAdmin. Apps that keep `registerWorkspaces: false` set `collectAdminArea` on their own workspaces and drop the hand-written nav lists. The option `includeDocumentDesigner` is removed because the document-designer navs carry their area.
migration: Remove `includeDocumentDesigner` from `createAdminShellFeature`. In app workspaces replace the lists of standard nav QNs with `collectAdminArea: "tenant"` or `"platform"`, and delete own users and system-check navs in favour of `admin-shell:nav:users` and `createReadinessFeature({ nav: { adminArea: "platform" } })`.

title: Nav option types split per workspace
includeTenantOverview turns the tenant overview off
includeDocumentDesigner lists the template navs in the admin workspaces
admin-shell requires the metrics and metrics-system features and builds its overview dashboards from a metrics list
detail: Dashboard panels gain the chart kinds `stacked-bars`, `segment-bars` and `stacked-area`, a subtitle, per-series tones, static query `params`, `ignoreScreenFilter`, an empty label and hint, a `span` (half/full width), a stat `sparklineField` and static `tone`, a `negative` tone, an unlabelled `stat-group` KPI strip and bar/badge list columns. Every panel shows skeleton, empty and error states with retry. A screen can declare a `timeRange` control and a `scope` badge and notice. The admin-shell overview screens use all of this and show the metrics of the new `metrics` and `metrics-system` features. `deliveries-by-channel` now labels the email, in-app and push channels.
migration:
Mount createMetricsFeature({ metrics: DEFAULT_METRICS }) and createSystemMetricsFeature({ metrics: DEFAULT_METRICS }) from the metrics bundled feature before admin-shell. DEFAULT_METRICS also requires the delivery, sessions, jobs and tenant features.

If you do not mount all of them, pass the same reduced list to all three: createMetricsFeature({ metrics }), createSystemMetricsFeature({ metrics }) and createAdminShellFeature({ metrics }). Overview panels exist only for metric ids in that list.

title: Bundled screen subtitles (admin-shell, jobs, auth-mfa, tier-engine, user-profile) are i18n keys with de and es translations
migration: Additive. Apps that override these screen descriptions keep working; apps that asserted the old English description text in tests now see the translated subtitle.
